Title: Clockwork Technician
Descriptions: Technicians are the ones who keep all the machinery running but dislike the outdoors. If you choose this faction you will ONLY be able to SELL vehicles and parts for currency. ONLY Technicians can BUY vehicles and parts. Each faction can also buy a unique outfit, and a unique vehicle, in addition to regular items. If you choose, you may give or sell these items to non-Technicians. Would you like to become a Technician? Please note it will display as faction 'East'.
Once you choose your calling select and accept the associated quest. You can only choose one faction so choose wisely. Speak to me again when you are ready.
ObjectiveText: Would you like to become a Technician? Please note it will display as faction 'East'.
